note: The single source of every message the Map shows and of the /guide page (scripts/build_guide.py). IDs are shared with the QGIS plugin. Levels: error = result blocked; warn = result shown, review it; info = explains a result or a change. 'source' lists where the text lives in code (checked by tests/test_guide.py).

messages.short_text: elevation request failed (T1)
messages.meaning: The elevation service did not answer, so there is no ground profile for this link. Nothing was substituted.
messages.what_to_do: Wait a minute and analyse again. If it keeps failing, check your connection.
messages.recheck: Run Analyze again on the same link.

messages.short_text: the elevation service returned an unexpected number of values (T1)
messages.meaning: The service answered, but not with one elevation for every sample point on the path. A partial profile is never used.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again. If it repeats, the service is having trouble; try later.
messages.recheck: Run Analyze again on the same link.

messages.short_text: a required elevation is null, NaN or non-numeric (R5)
messages.meaning: At least one point on the path has no elevation. It is never treated as 0 m, because that would invent a hill or a valley.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again. A path over open water or outside the elevation dataset can stay empty; use a survey for that link.

messages.short_text: elevation profile missing or its length does not match the sample points
messages.meaning: The ground profile is absent or does not line up with the path, so clearance cannot be computed.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again.

messages.short_text: record antenna height ... is outside 0.1-1000 m (R5)
messages.meaning: The antenna height on the record is not believable, so Velorona does not clamp or guess it.
messages.what_to_do: Correct the height in your file and import again, or analyse a link whose record has a valid height.
messages.recheck: Import the corrected file and analyse again.

messages.short_text: The elevation service (Open-Meteo) is busy (HTTP 429). Retrying in N s
messages.meaning: The elevation service is rate-limiting requests. Velorona waits and retries up to three times. Nothing is substituted while it waits.
messages.what_to_do: Wait. If every retry fails you get E-TERRAIN-SERVICE-FAILED; try again in a minute.
messages.recheck: The notice disappears when a retry succeeds.

messages.short_text: invalid coordinates (R4)
messages.meaning: A latitude or longitude is missing or outside its range, so no path exists.
messages.what_to_do: Fix the coordinates (decimal degrees, WGS84) and import again.

messages.short_text: zero-length link: identical endpoints (R4, R9)
messages.meaning: Both ends are at the same point, so there is no path to analyse.
messages.what_to_do: Check that site B has its own coordinates.

messages.short_text: Could not fetch live weather (Open-Meteo) for: <site> (T3)
messages.meaning: The weather model did not answer for one end of the link. Weather is needed at both ends, so no result is shown and nothing is substituted.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again in a minute.

messages.short_text: Open-Meteo weather service returned no current conditions (T3)
messages.meaning: The service answered without current conditions for that place.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again later.

messages.short_text: Open-Meteo `current.interval` missing or invalid (R3)
messages.meaning: The reply does not say how long its rain rate applies, so the rain rate cannot be used.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again later.

messages.short_text: precipitation type not reported: rain and showers absent (W1)
messages.meaning: The reply has neither a rain value nor a showers value. A missing rain rate is not read as dry.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again later.

messages.short_text: invalid <field> value (W4)
messages.meaning: A precipitation value in the reply is negative or not a number, so it is not used.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again later.

messages.short_text: a link parameter is outside its allowed range
messages.meaning: Frequency must be 1-100 GHz and fade margin 0.1-100 dB. The rain model refuses outside its range instead of extrapolating.
messages.what_to_do: Change the value (or the row in your file) to a value in range.
messages.recheck: Edit the value and analyse again.

messages.short_text: Open-Meteo weather service is busy (HTTP 429). Retrying in N s
messages.meaning: The weather model is rate-limiting requests. Velorona waits and retries up to three times; nothing is substituted.
messages.what_to_do: Wait. If every retry fails you get E-WEATHER-FETCH-FAILED; try again in a minute.
messages.recheck: The notice disappears when a retry succeeds.

messages.short_text: Some weather-station sources were unavailable. The result uses the model rain rate
messages.meaning: ECCC stations or radar did not answer. The result is built from the model rain rate only, and the evidence rows say what was and was not available.
messages.what_to_do: Read the Evidence rows before relying on the result. Analyse again later for a station comparison.

messages.short_text: Fetching weather at both endpoints (Open-Meteo, ECCC)…
messages.meaning: Weather is being requested for both ends of the link.
messages.what_to_do: Wait a few seconds.
messages.recheck: The message clears when the result opens.

messages.short_text: Fetching terrain elevations…
messages.meaning: About 50 elevation points along the path are being requested.
messages.what_to_do: Wait a few seconds.
messages.recheck: The message clears when the result opens.

messages.short_text: <layer>: <reason> No cellular/tower markers for this view; other layers are unaffected.
messages.meaning: A live layer (cellular or towers) did not answer for this view.
messages.what_to_do: Pan or zoom to retry. Other layers keep working.
messages.recheck: Move the map and the layer asks again.

messages.short_text: United States microwave data unavailable: <reason> Canada is unaffected.
messages.meaning: The US pack did not load. Canadian data is not affected.
messages.what_to_do: Zoom in again (the US pack loads at zoom 8 or closer) or reload.

messages.short_text: The My Data layer is hidden -- switch it on under Data sources
messages.meaning: Your imported link is analysed but its layer is switched off, so you cannot see it.
messages.what_to_do: Switch My Data on under Data sources.
messages.recheck: The link appears on the map.

messages.short_text: Nothing matches the current filters yet
messages.meaning: The filters and checked layers leave no records to act on.
messages.what_to_do: Relax Operator/Search, Frequency or Select Area, or check more layers.
messages.recheck: Records appear as soon as something matches.

messages.short_text: No source or layer matches. Clear the search to see all sources.
messages.meaning: The search box in Data sources matches nothing.
messages.what_to_do: Clear the search.

messages.short_text: Connecting to satellite data (CelesTrak) -- this may take a few seconds…
messages.meaning: Orbital elements are being fetched.
messages.what_to_do: Wait a few seconds.
messages.recheck: The message clears when positions appear.

messages.short_text: Satellites: N of M CelesTrak groups did not respond -- showing the rest.
messages.meaning: Some satellite groups are missing from the map.
messages.what_to_do: Switch the Satellites layer off and on to retry.
messages.recheck: Groups appear after a successful retry.

messages.short_text: Satellite data unavailable -- <reason>
messages.meaning: No satellite data could be loaded.
messages.what_to_do: Switch the Satellites layer off and on to retry.
messages.recheck: Satellites appear after a successful retry.

messages.short_text: Click a feature to select it. Shift-click a second feature
messages.meaning: How to start an analysis.
messages.what_to_do: Click a site or link; Shift-click a second one.
messages.recheck: The Analyze button lights up when the selection is valid.

messages.short_text: Nothing is selected.
messages.meaning: No analysis can run without a selection.
messages.what_to_do: Click a site or a Fixed Service link (Shift-click to add another), or use Import.

messages.short_text: This is an area selection.
messages.meaning: An area selection holds many features; analyses need specific ones.
messages.what_to_do: Press Clear, then pick two sites, one link, or one satellite plus one ground station. Export still exports the selected records.

messages.short_text: Imported links are analysed one at a time.
messages.meaning: Weather exposure runs on a single imported link.
messages.what_to_do: Press Clear and select one imported link.

messages.short_text: A Fixed Service link is analysed on its own.
messages.meaning: A link plus other features has no analysis.
messages.what_to_do: Press Clear and select just the link, or select two sites.

messages.short_text: 1 site selected. Shift-click a second site
messages.meaning: Path analyses need two sites.
messages.what_to_do: Shift-click a second site, or select a Fixed Service link on its own.

messages.short_text: N sites are selected, but path clearance and weather exposure use exactly two.
messages.meaning: Too many sites for a path analysis.
messages.what_to_do: Press Clear and pick two.

messages.short_text: Satellite selected. Shift-click a ground/earth station
messages.meaning: Look angles need one satellite and one ground station.
messages.what_to_do: Shift-click a ground or earth station.

messages.short_text: Ground/earth station selected. Shift-click a satellite
messages.meaning: Look angles need one satellite and one ground station.
messages.what_to_do: Shift-click a satellite.

messages.short_text: Look angles use exactly one satellite and one ground/earth station.
messages.meaning: The space selection does not match a look-angle analysis.
messages.what_to_do: Select one satellite and one ground station.

messages.short_text: Terrestrial sites and space features are not analysed together
messages.meaning: Ground sites and space features belong to different analyses.
messages.what_to_do: Select either two sites, or one satellite and one ground station.

messages.short_text: This combination has no analysis.
messages.meaning: The selection matches no analysis.
messages.what_to_do: Path clearance and weather exposure need two sites or one link; look angles need one satellite and one ground station.

messages.short_text: Exported <file or N records>.
messages.meaning: A file was saved to your downloads. The evidence export lists every value with its type and source.
messages.what_to_do: Open the file; the first lines explain the type key.

messages.short_text: Nothing to export yet -- select features, analyse a selection, or import your own links
messages.meaning: Export has nothing to write.
messages.what_to_do: Select features, run an analysis, or import links.
messages.recheck: The Export button fills in when there is something.

messages.short_text: Clear, N% above minimum -- comfortable margin.
messages.meaning: The line of sight clears the 60% first-Fresnel-zone standard with good headroom.
messages.what_to_do: Nothing to do.

messages.short_text: Clear, but only N% above minimum clearance -- limited headroom.
messages.meaning: It clears the standard, but not by much.
messages.what_to_do: Check antenna heights and the elevation source; consider a survey if it matters.

messages.short_text: Near threshold -- a ~10-15m elevation difference could change this result
messages.meaning: The elevation data is accurate to roughly this much, which is enough to flip the status.
messages.what_to_do: Verify with a survey before relying on it.
messages.recheck: A survey result replaces the model value.

messages.short_text: Marginal -- N% below standard microwave link clearance practice (60% of the first Fresnel zone)
messages.meaning: The path clears the ground but not the standard clearance.
messages.what_to_do: Review the profile; consider higher antennas or a different path.

messages.short_text: Obstructed -- ground is N m above the line of sight
messages.meaning: The terrain model rises above the line of sight. Trees and buildings are not in the model, so reality can differ.
messages.what_to_do: Treat as a stop sign for planning; confirm with a survey.
messages.recheck: Re-run with changed heights or a different path.

messages.short_text: Nothing stored yet. Values are saved when you analyse the weather exposure of a link.
messages.meaning: The store on this computer is empty.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse the weather exposure of a link.
messages.recheck: Values appear after the next weather analysis.

messages.short_text: Nothing to compare yet.
messages.meaning: There is no earlier value to compare with.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse again later; the comparison needs a value from about the chosen hours ago.
messages.recheck: Check again after a later analysis.

messages.short_text: no stored value from about N h ago
messages.meaning: Nothing was stored at that point in the past. A gap is a real gap: a failed fetch stores nothing.
messages.what_to_do: Pick a shorter window, or analyse again and compare later.

messages.short_text: The weather values Velorona Map fetched for your links, kept on this computer only.
messages.meaning: Stored values never leave your browser. Velorona does not receive them.
messages.what_to_do: Use Export CSV to keep a copy; Clear my history to delete them.

messages.short_text: This browser does not allow stored history here (for example a private window). Values are kept only until this tab is closed.
messages.meaning: Storage is blocked, so history lives in memory only.
messages.what_to_do: Use a normal window if you want the values to survive a restart.

messages.short_text: This computer's clock looks about N min behind the data source
messages.meaning: Stored times come from the data source; the comparison uses your computer's clock for "now".
messages.what_to_do: Correct the computer's clock.
messages.recheck: The warning clears after the next analysis.

messages.short_text: Storage on this computer is full, so history is kept only until this tab is closed.
messages.meaning: The browser refused more storage.
messages.what_to_do: Export CSV, then Clear my history; or free space in the browser.

messages.short_text: Storing history failed, so it is kept only until this tab is closed.
messages.meaning: Writing to the browser's database failed.
messages.what_to_do: Export CSV now if you need the values.

messages.short_text: History could not be cleared
messages.meaning: The delete did not complete.
messages.what_to_do: Try again; or clear the site's data in the browser settings.

messages.short_text: The retention choice could not be remembered after this tab closes.
messages.meaning: Your hours setting works now but will reset to 24 h next time.
messages.what_to_do: Set it again next session.

messages.short_text: Velorona Map does not predict outages or forecast link behaviour.
messages.meaning: Ask answers about current clearance and current-weather exposure, with evidence. It makes no forecasts.
messages.what_to_do: Ask about the selected links as they are now, or about your stored values.

messages.short_text: The public record gives the spectrum licensee, which is not a confirmed network operator
messages.meaning: A licence holder is not necessarily who runs the link.
messages.what_to_do: Use the licensee shown in the Source record.

messages.short_text: Weather history from outside this computer is not available.
messages.meaning: Velorona keeps only the values it fetched while you used it, on your own computer.
messages.what_to_do: Ask what changed in the last few hours, or what a value was N hours ago.

messages.short_text: Nothing is stored on this computer yet.
messages.meaning: There are no stored values to answer from.
messages.what_to_do: Analyse the weather exposure of a link first.

messages.short_text: Answered from values stored on this computer only. Nothing was fetched or sent.
messages.meaning: Every stored-value answer is built from your own history and nothing else.

messages.short_text: A numbered circle groups nearby points of one layer
messages.meaning: Dense layers are grouped to stay readable.
messages.what_to_do: Zoom in to separate the points.

messages.short_text: Leave a box blank for no bound on that side.
messages.meaning: A blank frequency box means no limit on that side. The frequency filter does not apply to Cellular/Mobile, Tower structures or the Space layers (Satellites, Ground/Earth Stations): those sources carry no comparable licensed frequency.
messages.what_to_do: Leave a box empty to remove that bound.

messages.short_text: Shows an identifying field per point.
messages.meaning: The label is the record's own identifier: authorization number, licensee or record ID, depending on the source. It is always available on hover and shown permanently once you zoom in far enough to read it without clutter.
messages.what_to_do: Hover a point, or zoom in.

messages.short_text: All eight template columns are required, one link per row.
messages.meaning: Use the template: all eight columns, named exactly as in it, one link per row, decimal degrees (WGS84), plain numbers without units. Optional for weather exposure: polarization (V or H) and fade_margin_db. A row that fails a check is skipped and the reason is shown.
messages.what_to_do: Download the template, fill it, and import.
messages.recheck: Import again after fixing the rows.

messages.short_text: Request received and kept as pending.
messages.meaning: You are signed up only after you confirm with a link we email you.
messages.what_to_do: Open the email and press the confirm link.

messages.short_text: Sign-up is not open yet. Nothing was saved.
messages.meaning: The server is not accepting sign-ups yet.
messages.what_to_do: Write to map@velorona.ai instead.

messages.short_text: We could not reach the server. Nothing was saved.
messages.meaning: The request never arrived.
messages.what_to_do: Check your connection and try again.
